Next, I should consider x and w. I value x higher than w ($68 > $62). I have priority 2 at both x and z. Since x is preferred to w, I should rank x second.

Finally, I have to choose between w and z. I value w higher than z ($62 > $48). Also, since most applicants favor y > x > w > z, w is more competitive than z. Therefore, I will rank w higher to maximize my chances of getting into a school I value more.

Therefore, my ranking should be y > x > w > z.
